AK4D.n: Slow-firing 7.62 battle rifle with top-tier per-shot damage; wiki keeps it in the A-tier AR row (GameRant ranked it D in Nov 2025).

B36A4.n: Jack-of-all-trades AR, stable across ranges; near-unanimous A-tier in recent lists.

EF88.n: Australian bullpup AR; sits in the Season 4 A-tier AR row.

KORD 6P67.n: Most controllable AR and safest Assault pick; survived every rework and is the consensus meta gun.

L85A3.n: Precision bullpup; versatile but a step behind the top ARs.

M16A4.n: Burst AR in the Season 4 A-row (RankedMeta's community list places it S).

M433.n: Close/mid-range AR with strong TTK, just behind KORD/M4A1.

NVO-228E.n: High per-shot damage (ACE32/Galil); wiki A-tier, Beebom ranked it S in Jan 2026.

SOR-556 MK2.n: SCAR-pattern accurate AR; A-tier after earlier C/D placements elsewhere.

TR7.n: Bullpup CQB AR; wiki demotes it to C for large maps, though RankedMeta/BFTactics still rate it A/S.

VCR-2.n: Season 4 AR in the A-row; strong close-range option.

Interdictor.n: Season 4 event-unlock sniper; RankedMeta B, BFTactics C (wiki lists it as rank-later once owned).

L115.n: Bolt-action AWM; RankedMeta B, BFTactics A.

M2010 ESR.n: Undisputed top sniper — one-shot power, high bullet velocity, generous sweet spot.

Mini Scout.n: Pocket/marksman sniper; wiki slots it as a C secondary-style pick (GameRant calls it the best sniper).

PSR.n: 10-round mag, effective past 90 m; top long-range sniper of the standard pool.

SV-98.n: Aggressive repositioning sniper with better mobility.

AK-205.n: Low-recoil carbine but low damage; wiki C for large maps (Beebom had it S in Jan 2026).

BROD 3.n: New Season 4 carbine; stable and sits in the A carbine row.

GRT-BC.n: Handles like an SMG but weak at range; Beebom C (recent lists split B/C).

M277.n: Small-mag carbine; usable but not a grind target.

M417 A2.n: Battle-rifle hybrid with solid tap-fire damage but punishing recoil/20-round mag.

M4A1.n: 900 RPM, near-vertical recoil, works on every class; universal meta pick.

QBZ-192.n: Accurate, dependable carbine; stable platform with bipod.

SG 553R.n: Top carbine — AR-level power without giving up carbine mobility.

SOR-300SC.n: .300 BLK carbine; dropped from S after Winter Offensive but still A.

GRT-CPS.n: Recent bullpup carbine; RankedMeta B, BFTactics A.

LMR27.n: Marksman rifle with low ceiling (RankedMeta/BFTactics C, GameRant F).

M39 EMR.n: Patient long-range DMR with excellent damage and fire rate for its class.

SVDM.n: Top DMR — three-shot kill with high RPM and stability rather than one-shot potential.

SVK-8.6.n: Launch favorite that still works; not a priority unlock.

VSSM.n: Suppressed 9x39 DMR; A-tier in RankedMeta and BFTactics.

DRS-IAR.n: LMG that plays like an AR — mobile, 700+ RPM, controllable recoil; aggressive LMG of choice.

KTS100 MK8.n: Mobile ULTIMAX LMG; S-tier in wiki, but Beebom/RankedMeta rank it lower (C).

L110.n: First LMG; reliable and accurate — wiki A (Beebom had it S).

M/60.n: M60 LMG; bulky with slow handling (Beebom/RankedMeta C).

M121 A2.n: MG5 LMG; RankedMeta C, BFTactics rates it S.

M123K.n: Highest-RPM LMG with fast TTK; B in wiki and GameRant.

M240L.n: Lightened M240; more mobile but low muzzle velocity.

M250.n: Next-gen LMG; usable B-tier (GameRant ranked it D).

RPK-74M.n: Mobile S-tier LMG with burst-friendly recoil.

RPKM.n: Slower/older RPK; B in wiki, D in Beebom.

ES 5.7.n: 20-round, near-zero-recoil 5.7 sidearm; ahead of the standard pool.

GGH-22.n: Glock 22 (.40 S&W) pistol; BFTactics A (GameRant rated it F in Nov 2025).

M357 Trait.n: Top revolver; competes with primaries as a finisher.

M44.n: Hard-hitting revolver that finishes fights outright.

M45A1.n: 1911-pattern .45 pistol; Beebom C, older GameRant F.

P18.n: Glock 18-style full-auto pistol; a finisher, not a loadout.

VZ. 61.n: Skorpion machine pistol; niche close-range finisher.

18.5KS-K.n: Semi-auto KSG shotgun; Beebom's D-tier (GameRant liked it for clearing buildings).

M1014.n: Fast semi-auto shotgun; forgiving if the first shot misses.

M87A1.n: Only S-tier shotgun — raw close-range lethality with minimal attachment fuss.

CZ3A1.n: CZ Scorpion Evo 3 A1; RankedMeta C.

KV9.n: Vector-pattern SMG — blistering 1080 RPM but tiny magazine; Beebom A.

PP-19.n: PP-19 Bizon SMG; RankedMeta B, BFTactics A.

PW5A3.n: Most forgiving SMG — elite accuracy, very low recoil; S-tier consensus across sources.

PW7A2.n: MP7 SMG; fast but hard to control at range.

SCW-10.n: APC-10 SMG — fastest sub-9.5 m CQB TTK, but a small magazine.

SGX.n: Beginner-friendly MPX SMG; solid CQB TTK and easy handling.

UMG-40.n: UMP40 SMG — six-shot kill out to 60 m, best ranged SMG.

USG-90.n: P90 SMG with a 50-round mag; wiki C (RankedMeta's community list places it S).
